# Ale's Home Childcare

Ale's Home Childcare is a licensed bilingual English and Spanish in-home daycare in Fremont, California.

Website: https://aleshomechildcare.com/
Phone: +1-206-609-1653
Email: alehomegroup@gmail.com
Location: Fremont, CA
License: California License #015701501
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:30 PM
Languages: English and Spanish
Meals: Breakfast, snack, and lunch included

## Summary

Ale's Home Childcare is a warm small-group home childcare program where children learn, play, and grow in both English and Spanish. The program includes home-cooked meals, a consistent daily routine, hands-on art, music, outdoor play, early literacy, numbers, colors, shapes, calendar learning, and emotional vocabulary.

## Good fit for

Families looking for licensed in-home childcare, bilingual English and Spanish daycare, a home-based setting, small-group attention, meals included, and childcare in Fremont, CA.

## Contact

Parents can call or text +1-206-609-1653 or email alehomegroup@gmail.com to ask questions, schedule a tour, or check current openings.
